FIWeatherWatch v0.1.6 — for testing
===================================

SIDELOAD
  fiweatherwatch.prg            -> GARMIN/APPS/
  fiweatherwatch-settings.json  -> GARMIN/APPS/SETTINGS/

Or upload fiweatherwatch-0.1.6.iq to the store as a Beta release.

Check the footer reads "v0.1.6" before testing anything below.


WHAT TO LOOK AT
---------------
1. SEA STATION LIST  (Connect Mobile -> Settings -> Sea)
   54 stations now, was 22. Coastal first, then 14 inland lakes.
   Five old entries are gone because they were broken, not because
   they were surplus:
     - "Helsinki Vuosaari satama" was returning HARMAJA's readings
     - "Föglö Degerby" is actually Lumparland Långnäs
     - Jussarö, Bogskär, Kristiinankaupunki Majakka report no wind
   New ones worth trying: Kirkkonummi Mäkiluoto, Inkoo Bågaskär,
   Sipoo Itätoukki, Lemland Nyhamn.

2. AN INLAND LAKE  e.g. Tampere Siilinkari, Puumala, Lappeenranta
   Wind should work normally. The waves page should say
   "Ei poijua alueella" — not "ei havaitsevaa poijua", which means
   a buoy exists but is quiet. You can still pick a buoy by hand if
   you want one.

3. PRESS SELECT on any page
   The footer should change to "Päivitetään…" and the download icon
   should brighten, then go back to the age and version. Previously
   Select refreshed silently and looked like it did nothing.

4. THE GLANCE
   Now refreshes at most every 5 minutes instead of on every scroll
   past it. Open the app, then check the glance — it should still
   show the fresh numbers, because it reads what the app fetched
   even when its own refresh is throttled.


KNOWN / NOT DONE
----------------
* The 14 lake stations are my picks from coordinates. If any is not
  really on boatable water, say so and it goes.
* The About page has never been screenshotted.
